Grace Chan

Grace Chan

Senior Talent Acquisition Specialist @ Luxoft DXC Technology

Project Description:

  • We are looking for a skilled Java Full Stack Developer to design, develop, and maintain modern web applications that deliver exceptional user experiences.
  • You will collaborate with cross-functional teams including backend engineers, architects, UX designers, DevOps engineers, and product owners to build scalable, high-performance applications using modern engineering practices and cloud technologies.


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop and maintain enterprise applications using Java and Spring Boot.
  • Design and develop scalable Microservices-based applications and REST APIs.
  • Develop modern, responsive frontend applications using React.js.
  • Design, develop and support Micro Frontend (MFE) architecture and independently deployable frontend modules.
  • Work with HTML, CSS, JavaScript and TypeScript for frontend development.
  • Integrate React/MFE applications with backend Microservices and REST APIs.
  • Develop reusable frontend components, services and UI modules following enterprise development standards.
  • Work with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift for containerisation and deployment.
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Jenkins and Git.
  • Work with Kafka for event-driven integration and asynchronous communication.
  • Work with MySQL, PostgreSQL and MongoDB.
  • Deploy and support applications on AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
  • Perform unit testing, integration testing, troubleshooting and production support.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical discussions, code reviews and architecture/design discussions.
  • Collaborate with architects, business analysts and other engineering teams to deliver end-to-end solutions.
  • Contribute to technical standards, reusable components, engineering best practices and continuous improvement initiatives.


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Java development.
  • Strong experience with Spring Boot and Microservices architecture.
  • Strong experience in REST API development, integration and enterprise application design.
  • Strong hands-on experience with React.js.
  • Good experience with JavaScript and TypeScript.
  • Strong understanding or hands-on experience with Micro Frontend (MFE) architecture.
  • Experience integrating frontend applications with backend Microservices/APIs.
  • Experience with Docker and Kubernetes/OpenShift.
  • Experience with Jenkins, Git and CI/CD practices.
  • Experience with Kafka and event-driven architectures.
  • Experience with MySQL, PostgreSQL and/or MongoDB.
  • Good experience with AWS and/or Azure cloud platforms.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise application development, software design principles and SDLC.
  • Ability to work effectively in an Agile development environment.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.


Nice-to-Have Skills Description:

  • Experience with Micro Frontend frameworks/patterns such as Module Federation.
  • Experience with Redux or other frontend state-management frameworks.
  • Experience with Node.js, Express.js or NestJS.
  • Experience with GraphQL.
  • Experience with Vue.js or Angular.
  • Experience with cloud-native application development and DevOps practices.
  • Experience in financial services / banking projects.
  • Experience working with enterprise-scale applications and distributed systems.
  • Experience with application performance monitoring and production troubleshooting.
  • Experience working in a multi-team Agile delivery environment.
